mapper.sql: ANALYSIS_ID, FINANCING_ID, FINANCING_TYPE, PRINCIPAL_AMOUNT, INTEREST_EXPENSE, FEE_COST, GUARANTEE_COST, OTHER_COST, TOTAL_COST, COST_RATE, CURRENCY_CODE, ANALYSIS_DATE, PERIOD_TYPE, PERIOD_VALUE, COMPANY_ID, COMPANY_NAME, CREATED_BY, CREATED_BY_NAME, CREATED_TIME, REMARK
mapper.select:
SELECT PERIOD_VALUE, PERIOD_TYPE, SUM(TOTAL_COST) AS totalCost, AVG(COST_RATE) AS avgCostRate, SUM(PRINCIPAL_AMOUNT) AS totalPrincipal FROM TBL_FINANCING_COST_ANALYSIS WHERE 1=1
AND COMPANY_ID = #{companyId}
AND ANALYSIS_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND ANALYSIS_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
GROUP BY PERIOD_VALUE, PERIOD_TYPE ORDER BY PERIOD_TYPE, PERIOD_VALUE
